name: Aurora Clean
description: Ravshan akademik uslub: yumshoq oq fon, professional ko'k ranglar, aniq tuzilgan kartalar va o'qilishi qulay jadvallar. Ilmiy, ta'limiy va rasmiy taqdimotlar uchun ideal.
prompt_guidance: Create a clear academic narrative with strong, specific section titles.
Each fact should be concise, complete, and readable in 1-2 slide lines.
Use 1-2 comparison tables when the topic naturally contains periods, categories, or measurable metrics.
Avoid generic language: every statement should add specific knowledge.
Prioritize readability with short sentences, active voice, concrete examples, and clean terminology.
